headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, and major blockquotes. Instills institutional authority and research-backed trust.

body.usage: Use for all body copy, navigation, labels, and data points. Clean, highly legible medical UI feel.

motion_and_interaction: Staggered Hero Reveal: Content blocks fade in upwards. 0.1s delay between pre-title, H1, subhead, and CTA.
Scroll-linked Reveals: Feature sections fade from 0 to 1 opacity with slight upward Y-translation (framer-motion whileInView).
Magnetic CTAs: The primary 'Request a Demo' button subtly follows the cursor on hover to increase engagement.
Soft Parallax: Product screenshots in hero and feature sections have subtle mouse-linked parallax to simulate spatial depth.
Texture: Subtle grain/noise overlay (5% opacity) applied strictly to deep navy sections to avoid flat digital look.

illustration_and_media.style: Subtle line-drawn dental / tooth / implant icons. Avoid generic colorful vector art. Use monochrome wireframe-style mockups paired against full-color clinical app screenshots.

hero_bg.description: Dentists viewing X-rays in a modern clinic. Use with a heavy white or mint gradient overlay to ensure text contrast.

clinic_action.description: Dentist examining patient with scanner. Use in 'For Clinicians' section.

testimonials.description: Smiling clinician portrait for testimonial quote card.

sections: Hero: H1 + Subhead + Primary CTA. Parallax layout of 2-3 overlapping real app screenshots.
Trust Bar: 'Trusted by pioneering dental colleges' with greyscale university logos.
Role Routing (Sub-hero): 3 interactive cards (Dental School, Private Clinician, Student) - clean mint hover states.
Product Tour: Bento grid showcasing the 4-phase workflow (Planning -> Surgery -> Healing -> Prosthetic).
Testimonials: Single high-impact quote card with portrait.
Bottom CTA: Deep navy block, 'Modernize your implant workflow today.', Mint button.
Hero: Deep navy background, clinical interface mockups.
Clinical Decision Support: Visual diagram showing biological safety margins (bone width/height).
AI Explain: 2-column layout showing the 'Explain Recommendation' UI backed by institutional guidelines.
Implant Library: Minimalist grid of 30+ system icons/names.
Compliance & Roles: RBAC and PDF generation showcase.
Hero: Academic focus, university clinic imagery.
Supervisor Oversight: Feature blocks on audit logs and student workflow approval.
Bulk Licensing: Clean pricing/demo table for departments.
Hero: Solo/group clinic efficiency.
iPad Native: High-res iPad mockup showing case management chair-side.
Patient Experience: Visuals of generated patient pre-op briefings and lab slips.
Pricing Grid: 3 tiers (Student, Clinic, Institution).
Contact CTA: All tiers route to 'Contact for Pricing' / Book Demo form.
Mission Statement: Beautiful serif typography, large text.
The Problem: Why dental workflows need modernization.
Founder Story: Placeholder image and text block.
HIPAA Safeguards: Listicle/Grid detailing 15-min auto-logout, audit logs, screen-capture blocking.
Data Architecture: Secure AWS/MongoDB technical diagram.
Index Grid: 3-column layout of articles (clinical guidelines, workflow research).
Newsletter Capture: 'Get product updates' inline form.
Split Layout: Left side copy + trust signal, Right side form.
Form: Routes to info@implanr.com.
Alternative: Calendly embed placeholder.

wordpress_considerations.block_usage: Build utilizing custom HTML/Tailwind templates wrapped into WordPress block templates or shortcodes. Avoid generic Elementor/Divi templates. Keep the DOM shallow.
wordpress_considerations.page_mapping: Create discrete WP Pages for a-j. Blog requires WP archive/single templates.

hero.subhead: The clinical standard for managing the 4-phase implant workflow. From planning to prosthetic delivery, Implanr protects your biological safety margins with institutional AI guidelines.

feature_block.body: Instantly validate bone height and width requirements against 30+ institutional implant systems. Our engine automatically flags biological safety risks, bridge/cantilever limitations, and provides AI-backed explanations for every clinical recommendation.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all mint text on white meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio (darken mint to teal if needed for text). All text on Navy must be soft white/pure white.
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query. Fallback to opacity fades without translation.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='request-demo-button-hero').

states.loading: Clean, medical-style indeterminate linear progress bar at top of viewport using Accent Mint.
states.empty: Subtle line-drawn tooth icon with soft grey text ('No cases found').
states.error_404: Hero-style page. H1: 'Margin Not Found'. Subhead: 'We couldn't locate this page. Let's get you back to the clinic.' CTA: 'Return to Home'.
